hits.title: Sprunki World Online RP - Play with Friends!
hits.description:
The World of Sprunki is a world of adventure and fun!

✨ What awaits you?

- 🗺️ Explore the world: find hidden Sprunki in different corners of the planet, discover new locations, and immerse yourself in an atmosphere of adventure.
- 🎮 Variety of modes: choose the game mode that suits you—be it the Ferris Wheel or dynamic jumping on colorful platforms.
- ⚡️ Obby + Block Builder: overcome obstacles, build blocks, and create your own routes, inspired by the atmosphere of cube games.
- ✨ Mini-games: diversify your gameplay with fun tasks and challenges, testing your dexterity and ingenuity.
- 💬 Live communication: communicate with friends and new acquaintances in the game chat, share impressions and secrets for completing levels.

📈 The game is constantly updated, adding fresh quests and exciting events. Join now and immerse yourself in a world of vibrant emotions and unforgettable discoveries!

"Sprunki World Online RP - Play with Friends!" is waiting for you!
hits.howToPlayText:
Computer controls:
WASD or arrow keys.

Phone controls:
Tap the screen and a virtual joystick will appear.
